exclusion_detail: Lead 19a is made by imidazole formation (1,2-diketone 2 + carbazole aldehyde 4 + amine intermediate + NH4OAc, general method A), Bu4NBr/K2CO3 coupling with the glycosyl orthoester precursor 28 to give 17a, then MeONa deacetylation (general method C). The article states that intermediates 2, 8, 10-13, 15-17, 20, 22, 25-31, 44-51, 57 were 'prepared following the procedures previously reported' (refs 35, 49-53; Scheme S1, SI not supplied), so the diketone, the amine linker and the sugar donor 28 have no procedure in the article.

lead.label: 19a
lead.why: Abstract: '19a coupled with a D-glucose 1,2-orthoester displayed better c-MYC G4 binding... than 1' and later 'we designed ... 19a could become a promising anticancer candidate'.

notes: Only the new intermediates 5, 23, 24 have procedures in the article; every final compound depends on previously reported intermediates. The compound numbering of 4a/17a in the experimental section is not self-consistent (4a is named as a hydroxyethoxy-ethyl imidazole while 17a carries a phenoxy-ethoxy-ethoxy linker), another reason not to transcribe a route. Only the main text was available (no SI file in readbundle).
